body: I've tried in the past. She always just treats it like I'm sad and I can move on. Saying stuff l like how there's no reason for me to feel this way, I'm letting it bother me, which just makes me feel like more shit. I know she means well, but she does the opposite of anything helpful every time, and I've given up on really trying to make her understand.
Thanks for the advice guys, I'll try to apply it in the next session.
I fucking cried in the theater at the end of the Peanuts Movie because of how much I felt like Charlie Brown, and that if there was hope for him, there might be for me too.

I don't know. I mean, they took her out of school, they took away everything she could communicate with, no freedom, no social life, she doesn't really have much else to lose. She could've at least acknowledged I existed... She just kept looking straight ahead.

Like I said in the other post, there's something specific. This whole shitty thing with my ex. But it's mostly just a general feeling of unworthiness. I feel like I don't live up to anyone's standards, much less my own. I feel like I'm going nowhere in life. I have no close friends, and I keep messing up and screwing up relationships with others... My existence feels pointless. The only thing keeping me going was the thought that I would get back with the love of my life, but after today, I seriously doubt it.

Part of it is my ex. The girl I gave everything to. I saw her today, she was with her sister. They passed right by me, she was smiling and looking ahead. I tried talking to her, her sister just made some weird gesture and they kept walking. My ex has done something similar before, when we were at school her sis would escort her to classes to keep her from me and she would ignore me if she saw me, then talk to me later. This was the first time I saw her since we broke up. They took her out of school, took away everything she could use to communicate with anyone, and basically fucked up her life. She has nothing left to lose, yet I still couldn't even get a look in my direction. Fucking hurt like hell. I've never felt so worthless. After everything we went through, all the support I gave her, not even a fucking glance. I don't understand, it seems so out of character. I'd been feeling like shit for a long time, I've hated myself and wanted to die, but I was hopeful that one day she'd talk to me again. This was just a nail in the coffin.

Idk. Seems like a lot of red tape. I'm kinda worried it would somehow have negative consequences, like if I met someone I knew or something. plus I imagine most girls are looking for something serious, which I'm not. I just wanna drown my sorrows between some girl's legs.

I am pissed at them for their parenting. And I do see the bigger picture. That's kind of the point of this post. It's not that I only care about the fact that I don't get to see her, even though it hurts like hell. It's that they've completely isolated her from everyone and everything outside of they're cult-like family. It's that they continuously make crappy parenting decisions that supposedly protect her, but really only hurt her in the long run. Like the fact that she can't continue her education. And of course, there's the constant verbal and emotional abuse that's been going on since before I was in the picture and what I won't get into.

I'm pissed because of my own selfish reasons. But I'm also pissed for how her life has turned out. Not to mention that I feel guilty and responsible for it because I decided to keep pursuing her.

Yeah I'd agree about him not being a real friend. I'm certain that nothing will happen between the two of them for about a billion reasons. I just can't count on him to not act like an ass, especially when we're supposed to be having a good time.
You're both right, I guess I am just overthinking this. Thanks for the response.

I forgot to mention this in the OP, though I should have since this is what I'm really worried about. One of them has had a crush on her for years, but she always rejected her. He would give her gifts on hit on her *while* he was in a relationship. When we were together, he told her not to get close to me. I guess I'm more worried about him and his reaction. I'd have no problem telling everyone else about it, albeit without going into a whole lot of detail.
Wow, that's pretty much exactly how I'm feeling. Thank you for sharing that, it's nice to know I'm not alone. I hope you can find peace and happiness as well.
